title: Los Angeles Grand City Tours and Stars Homes
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the best of Los Angeles on a 5½-hour tour through Hollywood, Beverly Hills, Santa Monica, and celebrity neighborhoods.

Capture photos of the legendary Hollywood Sign and enjoy a 15-minute stop at the iconic Beverly Hills Sign. See Rodeo Drive, the Beverly Wilshire Hotel, and homes connected to stars such as Johnny Depp, Justin Bieber, and Jennifer Lopez.

Enjoy 45 minutes for lunch and exploration at the world-famous Original Farmers Market, followed by a one-hour stop at Santa Monica Pier with beautiful Pacific Ocean views, the Ferris wheel, and a lively beach atmosphere.

Travel along the Sunset Strip, passing Whisky a Go Go, The Comedy Store, The Viper Room, and Skybar. On the return to Hollywood, see Paramount Pictures Studios, the Pantages Theatre, and the iconic Capitol Records Building.

Discover famous Los Angeles landmarks, celebrity culture, shopping districts, beaches, and memorable photo opportunities—all in one exciting experience.
